identity.title: Mass Estimates of a Giant Planet in a Protoplanetary Disk from the Gap Structures

paper_type_evidence.quote: We use the FITS image of the HL Tau that is publicly available from the ALMA archive site.
We apply the formula for the gap depth to observations of HL Tau and HD 169142.

evidence.quote: We use the data of dust continuum emission in Band 6 and 7 in our analyses, and assume the distance of $140$ pc.
We use the data of dust continuum emission in Band 6 and 7 in our analyses, and assume the distance of $140$ pc.

question.value: How can observed gap depths, together with disk temperature, constrain the mass of a giant planet embedded in a protoplanetary disk (applied to HL Tau and HD 169142)?

evidence.quote: We discuss how observed gap features can be used to constrain the disk and/or planet parameters based on the analytic formula for the gap depth.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00015.SV.

bands.value: Band 6 and Band 7 dust continuum (233 and 344 GHz central frequencies)

evidence.quote: where $\nu_6=233~\mathrm{GHz}$ is the central frequency at Band 6, $\nu_7=344~\mathrm{GHz}$ is that at Band 7
HL Tau was observed during the 2014 Long Baseline Campaign of ALMA

provided.value: 7 mm observations of HD 169142 (Osorio et al. 2014) used for gap depth

evidence.quote: Recent observations by (cite: Osorio2014) of 7 mm emission shows that there may exist a gap at $\sim 50$ AU

what.value: HD 169142 7 mm radial profile, aspect ratio ~0.1 and alpha=5e-4

evidence.quote: If we adopt the disk aspect ratio of $\sim 0.1$ and $\alpha=5\times10^{-4}$, as indicated by (cite: Osorio2014)

what.value: HL Tau ALMA continuum images (Band 6 and 7)

evidence.quote: HL Tau was observed during the 2014 Long Baseline Campaign of ALMA (cite: ALMA_HLTau)

simulations_or_models_as_data.value: 2D FARGO hydrodynamic simulation of Jupiter-mass planet at 40 AU, alpha=1e-3, h_p=0.1, delta=0.25, used to make mock 230 GHz images

evidence.quote: we have performed two–dimensional hydrodynamic calculations using FARGO (cite: Masset2000) to obtain the gap and spiral structures caused by a Jupiter mass planet at $R_p=40~\mathrm{AU}$

archive_products_used_as_is.value: Publicly available FITS image from ALMA archive site used

evidence.quote: We use the FITS image of the HL Tau that is publicly available from the ALMA archive site.
(see K15 for detail derivation)

unstated_but_needed: Which archive FITS files (names, resolution, beam) were used for Band 6 and 7
Whether images were convolved to a common beam before taking the ratio
Coordinates of HL Tau and exact gap depth measurement procedure
Details of the chi2 spiral fit

method.value: Average Band 6 and 7 images azimuthally over 130°<PA<140° between 20 and 50 AU about the brightest pixel

evidence.quote: between $20~\mathrm{AU}$ – $50~\mathrm{AU}$ averaged over the position angles of $130^{\circ}<\mathrm{PA}<140^{\circ}$
assume the distance of $140$ pc

analysis_steps.goal: Solve for optical depth and temperature

method.value: Solve T_br = T(1-exp(-tau)) in both bands with tau7=tau6(nu7/nu6)^beta, for beta=1 and 2

evidence.quote: We can derive $\tau_{6}$ and $T$ by using Equations ([\[eq:tau6\]](#eq:tau6)) and ([\[eq:tau7\]](#eq:tau7)) if we assume $\beta$.
shows the radial profiles of $\tau_6$ in the cases of $\beta=1$ and $\beta=2$

analysis_steps.goal: Estimate gap depth and aspect ratio, then planet mass

method.value: Ratio of tau max at 25 AU to min at 30 AU gives depth; T=55 K gives h~0.07; apply M_p/M_* formula

evidence.quote: we estimate the depth of the gap to be $\Sigma_p/\Sigma_0 \sim \tau_{\max}/\tau_{\min} \sim 1/3-1/7$

assumptions.value: c = 1 km/s (T/300 K)^1/2, stellar mass 1 Msun

evidence.quote: assume that the sound speed is $c=1~\mathrm{km/s} (T/300~\mathrm{K})^{1/2}$ and that the central star mass is $1~M_{\odot}$

validation.value: Checked for dust pile-up at gap outer edge in tau profile

evidence.quote: does not show any enhance at the outer edge. Hence, we can judge that dust filtration is not so effective in this case.

used_for.value: 2D hydrodynamic simulation of gap and spiral

evidence.quote: two–dimensional hydrodynamic calculations using FARGO (cite: Masset2000)

results_numeric.quantity: HL Tau gap depth at 30 AU

evidence.quote: $\Sigma_p/\Sigma_0 \sim \tau_{\max}/\tau_{\min} \sim 1/3-1/7$

results_numeric.quantity: HL Tau aspect ratio at 25 AU

evidence.quote: we derive $h \sim 0.07$ as an estimate of the disk aspect ratio
we obtain the lower limit of the planet mass as $\sim 0.4~M_J$

findings_qualitative.value: Dust filtration appears ineffective at the HL Tau 30 AU gap since no pile-up is seen at the outer edge

evidence.quote: At the gap of HL Tau, the dust filtration does not seem so effective becasue no significant dust pilling–up is seen at outer edge of the gap.

claims.hypothesis: A planet can explain the HL Tau 30 AU gap and its mass can be estimated from gap depth
claims.experiment: Used Band 6/7 brightness temperature ratio to get depth and temperature, applied analytic formula
claims.finding: A planet with mass of roughly 0.3 M_J or more could cause the gap

evidence.quote: we propose that a planet with $\mathrel{\hbox{\rlap{\hbox{\lower 4pt\hbox{$\sim$}}}\hbox{$>$}}}0.3$ is responsible for the observed gap

claims.hypothesis: The HD 169142 gap implies a planet
claims.experiment: Applied formula with depth 0.5, h~0.1, alpha=5e-4

evidence.quote: the planet mass that causes the gap structure recently found by VLA is $\mathrel{\hbox{\rlap{\hbox{\lower 4pt\hbox{$\sim$}}}\hbox{$>$}}}0.4 M_J$

limitations_admitted.value: Gaps only marginally resolved, so depths are upper limits

evidence.quote: the gaps we have focused on are only marginally resolved. Therefore, the gap depth quoted in this paper should be regarded as upper limit.

referee_caveats_inferred: Planet mass depends strongly on assumed h and alpha, which are poorly constrained
Gap depth from tau ratio sensitive to beta and unresolved beam
Equating dust and gas depth is an assumption

data_public_as_stated.value: HL Tau FITS image publicly available from ALMA archive

evidence.quote: We use the FITS image of the HL Tau that is publicly available from the ALMA archive site.

missing_for_reproduction: Exact FITS files and beam handling
reproducibility.score_reason: Public images and simple analytic formulas, but profile extraction details are sparse.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public HL Tau images and a short analytic recipe with numeric results.
